title: stachys rigida subsp. quercetorum
intro: Stachys rigida subsp. quercetorum, commonly known as Oak-leaved Betony, is a species of flowering plant in the mint family Lamiaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Oak-leaved Betony include reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and exhibiting sedative effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
